content.short: Airstack provides easy API for querying data across projects and blockchain ecosystems.
content.description: Airstack provides APIs that simplify querying across projects and blockchains, including Polygon. Users can tailor the feed by adjusting the algorithm, selecting data sources, and reviewing common user activities across dapps. For developers, it delivers a stream of recent transactions from Web3 projects such as OpenSea, POAP, ENS, Uniswap, and other protocols. The Airstack app makes Web3 data easy to browse, discover, and consume for integration, analysis, and building dashboards across services.

resources.title: Querying Onchain Data in One Request
resources.tldr: A worked build: ENS, Farcaster, POAPs and NFTs pulled through a single GraphQL query instead of four indexers.
